subject: Signal and System
questionText:
The sum of two or more arbitrary sinusoids is  
 
(a) always periodic 
 
(b) Periodic under certain conditions 
 
(c) Never periodic  
 
(d) Periodic only if all the sinusoids are identical 
in frequency and phase

options.text: Periodic only if all the sinusoids are identical

explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-08 (Periodic/Aperiodic, Even/odd,).
